subject: Application Design

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: No committed lock file for NuGet dependencies
findings.recommendation: Enable `<RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile>` and commit the generated `packages.lock.json` files so restores are fully reproducible.

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: Data source credentials live in tracked appsettings JSON files rather than environment/secret-store config
findings.recommendation: Keep only non-sensitive defaults in appsettings*.json; source Host/Port/UserName/Password from environment variables or a secret manager per environment (a UserSecretsId is already configured for local dev — extend the same approach to other environments).

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development, so dev and prod handle transport security differently
findings.recommendation: Enable UseHttpsRedirection (and HSTS) unconditionally, or at least in every non-local environment, so behavior doesn't diverge between dev and prod. See also SEC-WA-06.

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: Serilog writes application-managed rolling log files to a local logs/ folder in addition to stdout
findings.recommendation: Treat logs purely as an event stream to stdout/stderr and let the execution environment (container platform, OTel collector) handle routing, aggregation and retention, rather than having the app manage file rotation/retention itself.

strengths.subject: Application Design
strengths.title: Backing services (SQL Server / PostgreSQL) are attached purely via configuration, with a single 'Active' flag switching providers without code changes

checkResults.subject: Application Design
checkResults.reason: No packages.lock.json / nuget.config found anywhere in the repo.

checkResults.subject: Application Design
checkResults.reason: Connection credentials are structured as JSON config fields committed to the repo, not read from environment variables. Downgraded to Warning: the committed value is a placeholder, not a live credential.

checkResults.subject: Application Design

checkResults.subject: Application Design
checkResults.reason: Serilog file sink manages its own rolling/retention instead of relying purely on stdout.

notes: TF-03 evidence overlaps SEC-OP-05/06 and TF-10 evidence overlaps SEC-WA-06; expect the aggregator to keep the Security findings as primary.
